Countermeasures for cardiovascular and fluid-shift strain (NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4029], OCHMO-TB-031, OCHMO-TB-033, OCHMO-TB-015): perform 2.0 to 2.5 hours of daily combined resistive (ARED) and aerobic (T2 treadmill, CEVIS) exercise; use Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) as directed to counter cephalad fluid shifts; maintain hydration and electrolyte balance; report persistent blood pressure or heart rate deviations to your flight surgeon.

Countermeasures for microgravity bone and skeletal muscle loss (NASA-STD-3001 [V1 4027] & [V1 4028], OCHMO-TB-030, OCHMO-TB-031): complete 2.0 to 2.5 hours of daily high-intensity resistive (ARED) and aerobic (T2 treadmill, CEVIS cycle ergometer) exercise, and maintain adequate vitamin D and calcium intake. Complete today's cardio and resistance sessions in your To-Do list.

Countermeasures for spaceflight immune dysregulation (NASA OCHMO-TB-038, Crucian et al. 2018): prioritize stress reduction, maintain 7 to 8 hours of circadian-aligned sleep, continue balanced daily aerobic/resistive exercise, ensure nutrient-dense antioxidant and vitamin D intake, and verify habitat HEPA air filtration and antimicrobial surface disinfection. Report fever (>=38.0 C) or rash to your flight surgeon.
